title: Reflection Pawnbroker
text: Reflection Pawnbroker prices copied equipment as genuine and insists the expedition already sold the originals. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The duplicate comes with your fingerprints.

defeatReward.text: Reflection Pawnbroker is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
